description: Delta V is a team of high school students from India passionate about aerospace and technology. Named after Δv, the change in velocity that moves spacecraft, we aim to turn ideas into momentum. We want to learn, build, and solve real problems using NASA open data.
summary: Delta-V 26 is a kid-friendly browser game that works as a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer. Players lead three astronauts at a Moon base (Shackleton Crater) or a Mars base (Jezero Crater) for 30 sols. Each sol has two jobs, and players balance Power, Oxygen, Shield, Food and Science. Short bonus mini-games reward good work, and Science buys upgrades. The Sun drives the story: each sol uses one real day of solar flare records from NASA's DONKI database (May 2024, or 15 October to 13 November 2026). Bigger flares mean stormier weather, and a forecast helps players prepare. Events and lessons teach real space ideas such as radiation and shielding. It runs in a web browser with no install and plays best on a laptop or a phone held sideways. Built for NASA Space Apps 2026 by team Delta V. This is an independent project and is not endorsed by NASA.
details:
Delta-V 26 is a browser game that works as a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer. Players lead three astronauts at a Moon base (Shackleton Crater) or Mars base (Jezero Crater) for 30 sols. Each sol has two jobs, and players balance Power, Oxygen, Shield, Food and Science. Five short mini-games give bonuses, and Science buys four upgrades. Each sol uses one real day of solar flare records from NASA's DONKI database (May 2024, or 15 October to 13 November 2026); flare class sets the weather, and a forecast lets players plan ahead. Events and end-screen lessons teach real space ideas. Built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no install, in any browser. Code: https://github.com/Rutvik2010/delta-v-26

AI use: Claude (Anthropic), Gemini 3.8 flash (Google) and Gemini Carbon in Google Antigravity helped write the code and interface. A GPT-based assistant helped with content, tests and docs. The mission patch, logo and README were AI-generated. Sound effects are synthesized in code. data/space_weather_fallback.json is made-up offline sample data, not NASA data. Built for NASA Space Apps 2026 by team Delta V. Independent project, not endorsed by NASA.
